ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Topic: Critical Supercuts - Students in this course will learn how to apply the supercut video genre as an artistic research method for analyzing widely available multimedia archives. Projects will be research-driven and studio-based, with an emphasis on uncovering previously unseen (or heard) cultural, social, and political narratives from contemporary film, TV, TikTok and YouTube videos, podcasts, audiobooks, and other related forms.
